sentences.text: Para buscar el bolígrafo debajo del pupitre, Sergio tuvo que arrodillarse en el suelo.
sentences.en: To look for the pen under the desk, Sergio had to kneel on the floor.
sentences.ko: 책상 밑 볼펜을 찾으려고 세르히오는 바닥에 무릎을 꿇어야 했어요.

sentences.text: Para montar la cama, Lola tuvo que arrodillarse sobre una manta.
sentences.en: To assemble the bed, Lola had to kneel on a blanket.
sentences.ko: 침대를 조립하려고 롤라는 담요 위에 무릎을 꿇어야 했어요.

sentences.text: En la discusión entre sus dos amigos, Sergio intentó mantenerse neutral.
sentences.en: In the argument between his two friends, Sergio tried to stay neutral.
sentences.ko: 두 친구가 다툴 때 세르히오는 중립을 지키려고 했어요.

sentences.text: Lola pintó las paredes del piso nuevo de un color neutral para no cansarse.
sentences.en: Lola painted the walls of the new flat a neutral colour so she wouldn't get tired of it.
sentences.ko: 롤라는 질리지 않게 새집 벽을 무난한 색으로 칠했어요.

sentences.text: La cremallera de la mochila de Sergio se suele atorar justo cuando tiene prisa.
sentences.en: The zip on Sergio's backpack tends to get stuck just when he's in a hurry.
sentences.ko: 세르히오의 가방 지퍼는 꼭 바쁠 때 걸려서 안 움직여요.

sentences.text: El sofá se llegó a atorar en la puerta y Lola tuvo que desmontar las patas.
sentences.en: The sofa got stuck in the doorway and Lola had to take the legs off.
sentences.ko: 소파가 문에 끼여서 롤라는 다리를 떼어 내야 했어요.

sentences.text: En geografía, Sergio estudió el vasto territorio de la estepa siberiana.
sentences.en: In geography, Sergio studied the vast territory of the Siberian steppe.
sentences.ko: 지리 시간에 세르히오는 시베리아 초원의 광대한 땅을 공부했어요.

sentences.text: Desde la nueva casa, Lola ve un vasto campo de trigo hasta el horizonte.
sentences.en: From the new house, Lola sees a vast wheat field stretching to the horizon.
sentences.ko: 새집에서 롤라는 지평선까지 이어진 넓은 밀밭을 봐요.

sentences.text: La profesora le dijo a Sergio que admitir la propia ignorancia es el primer paso para aprender.
sentences.en: The teacher told Sergio that admitting your own ignorance is the first step to learning.
sentences.ko: 선생님은 세르히오에게 자기 무지를 인정하는 게 배움의 첫걸음이라고 말했어요.

sentences.text: Lola firmó el contrato por pura ignorancia, sin leer la letra pequeña.
sentences.en: Lola signed the contract out of sheer ignorance, without reading the small print.
sentences.ko: 롤라는 잘 몰라서 깨알 같은 조항도 안 읽고 계약서에 서명했어요.

sentences.text: En el partido de balonmano, Sergio logró interceptar el pase y marcó un gol.
sentences.en: In the handball match, Sergio managed to intercept the pass and scored a goal.
sentences.ko: 핸드볼 경기에서 세르히오는 패스를 가로채 골을 넣었어요.

sentences.text: Lola consiguió interceptar al cartero antes de que dejara las cartas en la dirección antigua.
sentences.en: Lola managed to catch the postman before he left the letters at the old address.
sentences.ko: 롤라는 집배원이 옛 주소에 편지를 두고 가기 전에 붙잡았어요.

sentences.text: Tras ganar el concurso de ortografía, Sergio se volvió un poco engreído.
sentences.en: After winning the spelling contest, Sergio became a bit conceited.
sentences.ko: 맞춤법 대회에서 우승한 뒤 세르히오는 좀 잘난 척하게 됐어요.

sentences.text: El agente inmobiliario era tan engreído que Lola buscó otra agencia.
sentences.en: The estate agent was so conceited that Lola looked for another agency.
sentences.ko: 부동산 중개인이 너무 거만해서 롤라는 다른 업체를 찾았어요.

sentences.text: El examen de física tenía un problema diabólico que nadie supo resolver, ni siquiera Sergio.
sentences.en: The physics exam had a fiendish problem that nobody could solve, not even Sergio.
sentences.ko: 물리 시험에 아무도 못 푼 악마 같은 문제가 있었는데 세르히오도 못 풀었어요.

sentences.text: Subir el piano por la escalera estrecha fue un plan diabólico, pero Lola lo consiguió.
sentences.en: Getting the piano up the narrow staircase was a fiendish plan, but Lola pulled it off.
sentences.ko: 좁은 계단으로 피아노를 올리는 건 악마 같은 일이었지만 롤라는 해냈어요.

sentences.text: Cuando el director prometió arreglar la calefacción, Sergio hizo un comentario cínico.
sentences.en: When the head promised to fix the heating, Sergio made a cynical remark.
sentences.ko: 교장 선생님이 난방을 고치겠다고 하자 세르히오는 냉소적인 말을 던졌어요.

sentences.text: El casero, bastante cínico, le dijo a Lola que la humedad era parte del encanto.
sentences.en: The landlord, rather cynical, told Lola the damp was part of the charm.
sentences.ko: 꽤 냉소적인 집주인은 롤라에게 습기도 매력의 일부라고 말했어요.

sentences.text: El equipo de Sergio consiguió arrasar en el torneo de ajedrez del instituto.
sentences.en: Sergio's team managed to sweep the board at the school chess tournament.
sentences.ko: 세르히오네 팀은 학교 체스 대회를 휩쓸었어요.

sentences.text: La tormenta llegó a arrasar el jardín de Lola la primera semana en la casa.
sentences.en: The storm devastated Lola's garden in her first week in the house.
sentences.ko: 이사 첫 주에 폭풍이 롤라네 마당을 쑥대밭으로 만들었어요.

sentences.text: La respuesta de la directora fue afirmativa, así que Sergio pudo organizar la fiesta de fin de curso.
sentences.en: The head's answer was affirmative, so Sergio was able to organise the end-of-year party.
sentences.ko: 교장 선생님이 허락해서 세르히오는 학년 말 파티를 준비할 수 있었어요.

sentences.text: Lola esperaba una respuesta afirmativa del banco para pagar la entrada.
sentences.en: Lola was waiting for a yes from the bank to pay the deposit.
sentences.ko: 롤라는 계약금을 내려고 은행의 승인을 기다렸어요.

sentences.text: Los compañeros llaman tacaño a Sergio porque nunca comparte sus galletas.
sentences.en: His classmates call Sergio stingy because he never shares his biscuits.
sentences.ko: 세르히오가 과자를 한 번도 안 나눠 줘서 친구들은 그를 짠돌이라고 불러요.

sentences.text: El antiguo dueño fue tan tacaño que se llevó hasta las bombillas, y Lola se quedó a oscuras.
sentences.en: The former owner was so stingy he even took the light bulbs, and Lola was left in the dark.
sentences.ko: 전 주인이 얼마나 인색했던지 전구까지 가져가서 롤라는 깜깜한 데서 지냈어요.

sentences.text: La excusa de Sergio para llegar tarde no era muy creíble.
sentences.en: Sergio's excuse for being late wasn't very believable.
sentences.ko: 세르히오가 지각한 핑계는 별로 믿기지 않았어요.

sentences.text: El precio del alquiler parecía poco creíble, así que Lola fue a ver el piso en persona.
sentences.en: The rent price seemed hardly believable, so Lola went to see the flat in person.
sentences.ko: 월세가 믿기지 않을 만큼 싸서 롤라는 직접 집을 보러 갔어요.

sentences.text: Sergio intentó aparentar calma antes de salir a hablar delante de toda la clase.
sentences.en: Sergio tried to appear calm before going up to speak in front of the whole class.
sentences.ko: 세르히오는 반 전체 앞에서 발표하기 전에 침착한 척하려고 했어요.

sentences.text: Lola intentó aparentar tranquilidad delante de los niños, aunque estaba agotada.
sentences.en: Lola tried to look calm in front of the children, although she was exhausted.
sentences.ko: 롤라는 지쳤지만 아이들 앞에서는 태연한 척하려고 했어요.

sentences.text: La comida del comedor estaba atroz ese día, y Sergio se comió solo el pan.
sentences.en: The canteen food was awful that day, and Sergio ate only the bread.
sentences.ko: 그날 급식이 끔찍해서 세르히오는 빵만 먹었어요.

sentences.text: El atasco para salir de la ciudad fue atroz, y Lola llegó de noche a la casa nueva.
sentences.en: The traffic jam getting out of the city was dreadful, and Lola reached the new house at night.
sentences.ko: 도시를 빠져나가는 정체가 끔찍해서 롤라는 밤에야 새집에 도착했어요.

sentences.text: La profesora notó que el interés de Sergio por la astronomía era genuino.
sentences.en: The teacher noticed that Sergio's interest in astronomy was genuine.
sentences.ko: 선생님은 세르히오가 천문학에 진짜 관심이 있다는 걸 알아차렸어요.

sentences.text: La alegría de los vecinos al recibir a Lola parecía genuina.
sentences.en: The neighbours' joy at welcoming Lola seemed genuine.
sentences.ko: 롤라를 맞이하는 이웃들의 기쁨은 진심 같았어요.

sentences.text: En tutoría, Sergio habló de la igualdad entre chicos y chicas en el deporte.
sentences.en: In form time, Sergio talked about equality between boys and girls in sport.
sentences.ko: 학급 시간에 세르히오는 운동에서 남녀 평등에 대해 이야기했어요.

sentences.text: Lola y su pareja reparten las tareas de la mudanza con total igualdad.
sentences.en: Lola and her partner split the moving tasks with complete equality.
sentences.ko: 롤라와 짝꿍은 이삿일을 완전히 똑같이 나눠요.

sentences.text: En el partido del viernes, Sergio hizo de árbitro porque tenía el tobillo lesionado.
sentences.en: In Friday's match, Sergio acted as referee because he had an injured ankle.
sentences.ko: 금요일 경기에서 세르히오는 발목을 다쳐서 심판을 봤어요.

sentences.text: El vecino de Lola es árbitro de fútbol y le ayudó a cargar la nevera.
sentences.en: Lola's neighbour is a football referee and helped her carry the fridge.
sentences.ko: 롤라의 이웃은 축구 심판인데 냉장고 옮기는 걸 도와줬어요.

sentences.text: En química, Sergio analizó la composición del agua del grifo de la escuela.
sentences.en: In chemistry, Sergio analysed the composition of the school's tap water.
sentences.ko: 화학 시간에 세르히오는 학교 수돗물의 성분을 분석했어요.

sentences.text: Lola cambió la composición del salón tres veces hasta que le gustó.
sentences.en: Lola changed the layout of the living room three times until she liked it.
sentences.ko: 롤라는 마음에 들 때까지 거실 배치를 세 번 바꿨어요.

sentences.text: Los alumnos mayores querían convertir el gimnasio en una discoteca para la fiesta, pero Sergio prefería un concierto.
sentences.en: The older pupils wanted to turn the gym into a disco for the party, but Sergio preferred a concert.
sentences.ko: 선배들은 파티 때 체육관을 클럽처럼 꾸미고 싶어 했지만 세르히오는 공연이 더 좋았어요.

sentences.text: El piso nuevo de Lola está encima de una discoteca, y los sábados no hay quien duerma.
sentences.en: Lola's new flat is above a nightclub, and on Saturdays nobody can sleep.
sentences.ko: 롤라의 새집은 클럽 위에 있어서 토요일엔 잠을 잘 수가 없어요.

sentences.text: Para el desfile de carnaval del colegio, Sergio se disfrazó de pirata.
sentences.en: For the school carnival parade, Sergio dressed up as a pirate.
sentences.ko: 학교 카니발 행진 때 세르히오는 해적 분장을 했어요.

sentences.text: Lola se mudó en pleno carnaval y el camión no podía pasar por las calles llenas de gente.
sentences.en: Lola moved in the middle of carnival and the truck couldn't get through the crowded streets.
sentences.ko: 롤라는 한창 카니발 때 이사해서 트럭이 붐비는 거리를 지나갈 수 없었어요.

sentences.text: En matemáticas, Sergio dibujó la gráfica sin marcar bien el eje vertical.
sentences.en: In maths, Sergio drew the graph without properly marking the vertical axis.
sentences.ko: 수학 시간에 세르히오는 세로축 표시를 제대로 안 하고 그래프를 그렸어요.

sentences.text: Al desmontar el ventilador, a Lola se le perdió el eje de las aspas.
sentences.en: When taking the fan apart, Lola lost the shaft for the blades.
sentences.ko: 선풍기를 분해하다가 롤라는 날개 축을 잃어버렸어요.

sentences.text: En la simulación de la ONU, a Sergio le tocó hacer de canciller y negociar un acuerdo.
sentences.en: In the model UN, Sergio got to play the foreign minister and negotiate an agreement.
sentences.ko: 모의 유엔에서 세르히오는 외무장관 역을 맡아 협정을 협상했어요.

sentences.text: En la casa nueva, Lola encontró un periódico viejo con una foto del canciller de entonces.
sentences.en: In the new house, Lola found an old newspaper with a photo of the chancellor of the time.
sentences.ko: 새집에서 롤라는 당시 총리 사진이 실린 옛 신문을 찾았어요.

sentences.text: En la feria de comidas del mundo, Sergio probó un plato sirio de garbanzos y le encantó.
sentences.en: At the world food fair, Sergio tried a Syrian chickpea dish and loved it.
sentences.ko: 세계 음식 축제에서 세르히오는 시리아식 병아리콩 요리를 먹어 보고 아주 좋아했어요.

sentences.text: La vecina de Lola le trajo pan sirio recién hecho para darle la bienvenida.
sentences.en: Lola's neighbour brought her freshly made Syrian bread to welcome her.
sentences.ko: 롤라의 이웃은 환영 인사로 갓 구운 시리아 빵을 가져다줬어요.

sentences.text: Sergio entrena con la élite del atletismo juvenil de su región.
sentences.en: Sergio trains with the elite of youth athletics in his region.
sentences.ko: 세르히오는 자기 지역 청소년 육상 정예 선수들과 함께 훈련해요.

sentences.text: El barrio al que se mudó Lola era antes zona de la élite de la ciudad.
sentences.en: The neighbourhood Lola moved to used to be an area for the city's elite.
sentences.ko: 롤라가 이사 간 동네는 예전에 도시 상류층이 살던 곳이었어요.

sentences.text: Según el reglamento de la escuela, Sergio no puede llevar gorra en clase.
sentences.en: According to the school rules, Sergio can't wear a cap in class.
sentences.ko: 학교 규정에 따라 세르히오는 수업 중에 모자를 쓸 수 없어요.

sentences.text: El reglamento de la comunidad prohíbe a Lola tender la ropa en el balcón.
sentences.en: The building rules forbid Lola from hanging washing on the balcony.
sentences.ko: 공동주택 규정 때문에 롤라는 발코니에 빨래를 널 수 없어요.

sentences.text: Sergio escribió un cómic sobre un vengador enmascarado que defiende a los alumnos nuevos.
sentences.en: Sergio wrote a comic about a masked avenger who defends the new pupils.
sentences.ko: 세르히오는 전학생들을 지켜 주는 가면 쓴 복수자 만화를 그렸어요.

sentences.text: El hijo de Lola se disfrazó de vengador con una capa hecha de una caja de la mudanza.
sentences.en: Lola's son dressed up as an avenger with a cape made from a moving box.
sentences.ko: 롤라의 아들은 이삿짐 상자로 만든 망토를 두르고 복수자 분장을 했어요.

sentences.text: El profesor de lengua empieza cada lunes con un acertijo, y Sergio casi siempre lo resuelve.
sentences.en: The language teacher starts every Monday with a riddle, and Sergio almost always solves it.
sentences.ko: 국어 선생님은 월요일마다 수수께끼로 수업을 시작하는데 세르히오가 거의 늘 맞혀요.

sentences.text: Encontrar las llaves de la casa nueva entre tantas cajas fue un acertijo para Lola.
sentences.en: Finding the keys to the new house among so many boxes was a puzzle for Lola.
sentences.ko: 상자 더미 속에서 새집 열쇠를 찾는 건 롤라에게 수수께끼였어요.

sentences.text: En el laboratorio, Sergio pesó cada miligramo de sal con una balanza digital.
sentences.en: In the lab, Sergio weighed every milligram of salt with a digital scale.
sentences.ko: 실험실에서 세르히오는 전자저울로 소금을 밀리그램 단위까지 쟀어요.

sentences.text: El médico le recetó a Lola un analgésico de pocos miligramos para el dolor de espalda tras la mudanza.
sentences.en: The doctor prescribed Lola a low-milligram painkiller for back pain after the move.
sentences.ko: 의사는 이사 뒤 허리가 아픈 롤라에게 저용량 진통제를 처방했어요.

sentences.text: El entrenador quiere que Sergio juegue con un estilo más ofensivo en el próximo partido.
sentences.en: The coach wants Sergio to play in a more attacking style in the next match.
sentences.ko: 코치는 다음 경기에서 세르히오가 더 공격적으로 뛰길 바라요.

sentences.text: El casero le dejó a Lola una nota con un tono algo ofensivo sobre el ruido.
sentences.en: The landlord left Lola a note about the noise in a rather offensive tone.
sentences.ko: 집주인은 롤라에게 소음에 대해 좀 무례한 말투의 쪽지를 남겼어요.

sentences.text: En la novela que leía Sergio para clase, unos piratas intentaban raptar al hijo de un gobernador.
sentences.en: In the novel Sergio was reading for class, some pirates tried to kidnap a governor's son.
sentences.ko: 세르히오가 수업 때문에 읽던 소설에서 해적들이 총독의 아들을 납치하려 했어요.

sentences.text: Lola bromeó con que iba a raptar al gato del vecino porque no paraba de entrar en su casa.
sentences.en: Lola joked that she was going to kidnap the neighbour's cat because it kept coming into her house.
sentences.ko: 롤라는 이웃 고양이가 자꾸 집에 들어와서 납치해 버리겠다고 농담했어요.

sentences.text: En el consejo escolar, Sergio presentó una moción para tener más fuentes de agua.
sentences.en: At the school council, Sergio put forward a motion to have more water fountains.
sentences.ko: 학생회 회의에서 세르히오는 식수대를 늘리자는 안건을 냈어요.

sentences.text: En la reunión de vecinos, Lola votó a favor de la moción para pintar la fachada.
sentences.en: At the residents' meeting, Lola voted in favour of the motion to paint the façade.
sentences.ko: 주민 회의에서 롤라는 건물 외벽을 칠하자는 안건에 찬성했어요.

sentences.text: En historia, Sergio aprendió que una milicia de campesinos defendió el pueblo durante la revolución.
sentences.en: In history, Sergio learned that a peasant militia defended the town during the revolution.
sentences.ko: 역사 시간에 세르히오는 혁명 때 농민 민병대가 마을을 지켰다는 걸 배웠어요.

sentences.text: En el desván de Lola había un uniforme antiguo de una milicia local.
sentences.en: In Lola's attic there was an old uniform from a local militia.
sentences.ko: 롤라네 다락에는 지역 민병대의 옛 제복이 있었어요.

sentences.text: El viejo balón firmado por el equipo campeón es una reliquia para Sergio.
sentences.en: The old ball signed by the champion team is a treasured relic for Sergio.
sentences.ko: 우승팀 사인이 있는 낡은 공은 세르히오에게 보물 같은 유물이에요.

sentences.text: Lola envolvió con cuidado la reliquia familiar: el reloj de pared de su bisabuela.
sentences.en: Lola carefully wrapped the family heirloom: her great-grandmother's wall clock.
sentences.ko: 롤라는 집안 보물인 증조할머니의 벽시계를 조심스럽게 쌌어요.

sentences.text: En la semana cultural, Sergio presentó un trabajo sobre el código de honor del samurái.
sentences.en: During culture week, Sergio presented a project on the samurai's code of honour.
sentences.ko: 문화 주간에 세르히오는 사무라이의 명예 규범에 대한 발표를 했어요.

sentences.text: El hijo de Lola colgó en su cuarto nuevo un póster de un samurái con armadura.
sentences.en: Lola's son hung a poster of a samurai in armour in his new room.
sentences.ko: 롤라의 아들은 새 방에 갑옷 입은 사무라이 포스터를 붙였어요.

sentences.text: Tras la eliminación de su equipo en semifinales, Sergio no habló en todo el viaje de vuelta.
sentences.en: After his team's elimination in the semi-finals, Sergio didn't speak the whole way back.
sentences.ko: 준결승에서 팀이 탈락한 뒤 세르히오는 돌아오는 내내 말이 없었어요.

sentences.text: La eliminación de trastos inútiles le llevó a Lola un fin de semana entero.
sentences.en: Getting rid of useless junk took Lola a whole weekend.
sentences.ko: 쓸모없는 잡동사니를 정리하는 데 롤라는 주말을 통째로 썼어요.

sentences.text: En biología, Sergio observó la transformación de la oruga en mariposa.
sentences.en: In biology, Sergio observed the transformation of the caterpillar into a butterfly.
sentences.ko: 생물 시간에 세르히오는 애벌레가 나비로 변하는 과정을 관찰했어요.

sentences.text: Después de la reforma, la transformación de la cocina de Lola fue increíble.
sentences.en: After the renovation, the transformation of Lola's kitchen was incredible.
sentences.ko: 공사 뒤 롤라네 부엌은 몰라보게 달라졌어요.

sentences.text: En la obra de teatro, Sergio hacía de domador de circo y llevaba un látigo de cartón.
sentences.en: In the play, Sergio played a circus tamer and carried a cardboard whip.
sentences.ko: 연극에서 세르히오는 서커스 조련사 역을 맡아 종이 채찍을 들었어요.

sentences.text: En el trastero, Lola encontró un látigo de montar que había sido de su abuelo.
sentences.en: In the storeroom, Lola found a riding whip that had belonged to her grandfather.
sentences.ko: 창고에서 롤라는 할아버지가 쓰던 승마용 채찍을 찾았어요.

sentences.text: En el libro de historia de Sergio, el verdugo aparece solo en una ilustración del castillo.
sentences.en: In Sergio's history book, the executioner appears only in an illustration of the castle.
sentences.ko: 세르히오의 역사책에서 사형 집행인은 성 그림 속에만 나와요.

sentences.text: Mientras desempaquetaba, Lola escuchó un podcast de historia sobre el último verdugo de la ciudad.
sentences.en: While unpacking, Lola listened to a history podcast about the city's last executioner.
sentences.ko: 짐을 풀면서 롤라는 도시의 마지막 사형 집행인을 다룬 역사 팟캐스트를 들었어요.

sentences.text: Sergio hizo un trabajo sobre la vida de un zar ruso y su corte.
sentences.en: Sergio did a project on the life of a Russian tsar and his court.
sentences.ko: 세르히오는 러시아 차르의 삶과 궁정에 대한 과제를 했어요.

sentences.text: Entre los libros de Lola apareció la biografía de un zar ruso.
sentences.en: Among Lola's books turned up the biography of a Russian tsar.
sentences.ko: 롤라의 책 사이에서 러시아 차르 한 명의 전기가 나왔어요.
